The footprint follows the official EPSG:4326 GIS geometry using the project’s documented approximate local conversion and remains in campus coordinates with identity transform. A small deduction reflects 1.02 m generalization tolerance and unpublished GIS positional accuracy.

Purdue BME Floor Plans snapshot explicitly documents a basement and first, second, and third floors; the model represents three above-ground levels, so the GIS four-level count is plausibly reconciled.

The preview uses a flat low-slope roof, but the available photo is an oblique corner view with no roof plan/elevation. The roof silhouette and parapet height remain visually plausible rather than dimensionally verified.

The model's upper facade is mostly blank pale wall with repeated small punched windows; it does not reproduce the prominent large central curtain wall in the photo. findings.finding: The primary facade cue is absent: the reference photo has a broad two-level glazed central wall, while the preview shows mostly opaque upper cladding with small repeated windows. Add or revise the central curtain-wall bay and check from the documented photo-facing side.
The documented recessed entrance is not visually legible in the saved preview; the west/east entrance markers have explicitly approximate placement and are not survey-backed.
The 14.2 m total height, floor-to-floor spacing, roof level, and parapet height are estimates. The source confirms basement plus three above-ground floors but does not give measured elevations.

The 178-point GIS outline was generalized to an 88-edge model outline, with independently recomputed maximum source-to-outline deviation of 1.01 m. The GIS is not a certified survey and its feature edit date is unavailable.
A single oblique exterior image supports the broad facade treatment but cannot verify hidden elevations, exact window spacing, door positions, or roof plan.
